operator-walkthrough.ref: 2026-10-21 Billed card on the Today page (SalesCard). Nour sees six chips in order: Today, Yesterday, 7 days, 30 days, This month, Last month; 7 days is still the selected one on load. Tap Today on a normal morning, when the invoice mirror is current through yesterday: the card shows 'Not synced yet. The invoice mirror is current through <yesterday's date>.' and no dollar figure, no invoice count, no 'What this excludes' button (a $0 there would read as a dead shop). Tap Yesterday: the usual figure, 'N invoices · Yesterday' and the mirror line. Once the mirror reaches today, Today shows its real figure; a synced day with no invoices (a holiday) shows a real $0 with '0 invoices'. A failed read on either chip still shows 'Sales unreadable: this is UNKNOWN, not $0'. Other chips are unchanged; the server marks any window that runs past the mirror (windowAfterThrough) but only Today and Yesterday change what is shown. Evidence: client/src/__tests__/sales-card.test.tsx (10 new tests, 8 red before the change) and server/shopSales.test.ts (day windows in America/New_York across 23:00/01:00 ET and both DST days, windowAfterThrough truth table, paidInvoiceRevenue read with a mocked db, router/service/card period-list parity; 29 red before the change).
